items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: Pianist Hal Galper has led a diverse as a leader of his own trios, a sideman with Phil Woods and Cannonball Adderley

ctx.x: Right. And the Guerilla Band — I guess what made me say that is this little book here. Did you ever see this one? It’s a biodiscography of Cannonball and there’s a quote here from you that I guess appeared in DownBeat after you left the group. “I had pure joy, I wheeled the electric piano down in its case, tossed it in the Hudson River and watched the bubbles come up.”

Yes. I guess I have a tendency to the grand gesture. You know. It was a grand gesture. I, after much thought, realized — and then Cannon kept trying to get me to play the acoustic piano and I wouldn’t do it.
Oh I’m glad you said that.
